name: Ritter Communications
notes: Researched from the public rittercommunications.com Bill Pay page and help.rittercommunications.com Account & Billing articles only (no sign-in). Online billing runs on a separate billing site linked as Pay My Bill / Account Login (billing.rightfiber.com, also pay.rittercommunications.com) and the MyRitter app. Setup: register with the invoice number and amount due from the latest bill (neither is a dossier registration field; account number + email is the closest model), log in using the account email as both username and password, verify from the billing@ email, choose a security question, then set a real password in Settings; so the identifier is email. Payments: online/app, phone 888.336.4466 (24/7), mail to Ritter Communications, Attn: Payment Processing, PO Box 709, Searcy, AR 72145-0709, cash at the Jonesboro office or PayNearMe retailers (residential only). One-time credit card payments carry a 3% convenience fee; AutoPay customers are exempt and checking/savings is free (cardPercent 3, autopayCardPercent 0). AutoPay: dashboard > automatic payments. Paperless: Settings > General > Web Bill Only > Change Preferences; a $5 credit for signing up. Late fee generated when the invoice is not paid by the due date (amount not published). Suspended service is restored within six hours of an online payment; permanently disconnected accounts must call. Due dates can be changed by calling. No bundle discounts. No pay-without-signing-in option and no cancellation article exist on the pages used: guest_pay keeps the family default; cancel_service is unknown with the customer care number. Reviewer (t20, 2026-10-10): Re-checked the seven cited pages plus the PayNearMe and due-date articles. Fixed the PayNearMe retailer list (Dollar General is not named; Family Dollar, CVS, Casey’s, ACE Cash Express and Walmart are) and added the PayNearMe text-to-pay link, which is a phone-initiated link rather than a web lookup, so guest_pay is not changed. Reviewer: guest_pay set to unsupported (inferred) with a customer-facing note: the family default showed a web account-number/ZIP lookup that Ritter does not offer; its no-login option is a PayNearMe text-to-pay link sent after calling.

help.title: How to pay your Ritter bill
paragraphs: Pay online on Ritter's billing site or in the MyRitter app, by phone 24/7 at 888.336.4466, or by mail: send a check or money order with your account number to Ritter Communications, Attn: Payment Processing, PO Box 709, Searcy, AR 72145-0709.

Cash is accepted in the Jonesboro office lobby (Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.) and, for residential bills, through PayNearMe at retailers such as Family Dollar, CVS Pharmacy, Casey’s General Store, ACE Cash Express and Walmart. PayNearMe also takes one-time card, bank, Apple Pay and Google Pay payments, and Ritter can text you a personal payment link so you can pay without a username or password.
One-time credit card payments carry a 3% convenience fee. AutoPay customers are exempt, and paying from a checking or savings account is always free.

help.title: Set up online bill pay
paragraphs: Have your invoice number and amount due from your latest bill ready. On Ritter's billing site, log in using the email on your account as both the username and the password, then open the verification email from Ritter and follow the link back to the login page.
Log in again the same way, choose and answer a security question, then go to Settings and set a new password (enter your email as the current password).

help.title: Paperless billing
paragraphs: Paperless billing emails your bill instead of mailing it, and you get a $5 credit for signing up. Register for online billing first, then go to Settings, choose General, select Web Bill Only and click Change Preferences. Each month you get an email with a PDF of your bill.

help.title: Late fees and restoring service
paragraphs: A late fee is generated when your invoice is not paid on or before its due date; AutoPay helps you avoid it. To change your due date, call Customer Care at 888.336.4466.

Unpaid service is suspended before it is disconnected. While suspended you can still pay on the online billing site, and service comes back within six hours of the payment. If the account was permanently disconnected, call 888.336.4466 to set up service again.
